per_role_checks.transfer_principle: Use layered proof gates so one stale artifact cannot certify a new workline.
per_role_checks.rejected_analogy_reason: Human meeting minutes alone were rejected because they are not machine-checkable.

per_role_checks.transfer_principle: Bind referenced artifacts by digest so a path name alone is not sufficient proof.
per_role_checks.rejected_analogy_reason: A single boolean flag was rejected because it cannot carry enough independent evidence.

per_role_checks.transfer_principle: Every claimed protection needs a negative case that proves the bypass is rejected.
per_role_checks.rejected_analogy_reason: Happy-path-only certification was rejected because it would not catch stale proof reuse.

per_role_checks.transfer_principle: Record what the guard cannot prove instead of silently upgrading structure checks to truth.
per_role_checks.rejected_analogy_reason: Cryptographic proof of external model cognition was rejected because the tool provides no signed receipt.

per_role_checks.transfer_principle: Put the current-workline guard into each relevant entry point, not only the preferred command.
per_role_checks.rejected_analogy_reason: Manual operator discipline was rejected because future sessions need automatic enforcement.

per_role_checks.transfer_principle: Treat any single self-reported trace as weaker than an independently hashed artifact plus negative tests.
per_role_checks.rejected_analogy_reason: Perfect-proof language was rejected because the external tool lacks cryptographic receipts.
